title: Concept: Post-install hook runs arbitrary code after resolution
description: package.json declares a package.json that runs a `postinstall` script, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a package.json that runs a `postinstall` script.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a package.json that runs a `postinstall` script.
